title: Five-box storyboard
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y4 lesson 16 (Pupil PDF worksheet: five-box storyboard)
intro: Lesson 16: Umar ibn al-Khattab (رضي الله عنه) accepts Islam. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Umar before Islam
points: Umar was strong and respected in Makkah
At first he was against Islam
He set out angry one day

timeline.text: Umar hears his sister and her husband are Muslim
He finds them reading the Qur'an
He reads the start of Surah Ta Ha
His heart softens; he goes to the Prophet ﷺ

panels.title: A strength for the Muslims
points: Muslims could now pray more openly
Ibn Mas'ud: 'We have been strong since Umar became Muslim'

blocks.text: Words and objects only (a scroll, a door, a path); no people.

keywords.def: when someone's beliefs and feelings change

questions.q: Explain how Umar's Islam helped the Muslims.
questions.a: He was strong and respected, so the Muslims felt safer and could worship more openly.

questions.q: Write the story as a five-box storyboard on the pupil PDF (words and objects only: a scroll, a door, a path).
questions.a: Five boxes in the right order with a sentence each

questions.q: Extend: what does Umar's story teach about not giving up on people?
questions.a: Anyone can be guided; we should be kind and make du'a for them.

questions.q: Stretch: why might the Qur'an's words have such power?
questions.a: They are Allah's words: true, beautiful and speaking to the heart.

options: Hearing the words of the Qur'an
questions.a: A) Hearing the words of the Qur'an. The Qur'an's words moved him.
Hearing the Qur'an softened his heart.
